categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the consumer electronics protective and functional materials industry. Main business segments include protective products (environmental-friendly materials like biodegradable and recyclable products) and functional products (carbon fiber products, die-cut structural components). The company serves as a comprehensive solution provider for protective and functional materials to consumer electronics manufacturers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including die-cutting, lamination, and molding processes. Core technologies include carbon fiber composite processing, plastic molding, paper-based material processing, and environmental-friendly material development. The company employs self-developed production methods for carbon fiber lightweight structures, biodegradable materials using plant-based resources (bamboo, sugarcane), and recycled plastic (OBP) processing with UL2809 certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are consumer electronics manufacturers including brand owners, contract manufacturers, and component suppliers. Main end markets include personal computers, smartphones, smart wearable devices, and servers. The company serves leading global consumer electronics brands and has established long-term strategic partnerships with major customers, with the top customer representing 48.22% of annual sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across multiple regions with production bases in Anhui, Hubei, Guangdong, Sichuan, Jiangsu, and Fujian provinces in mainland China. International operations include subsidiaries in Mexico (BROMAKE, S.A. DE C.V.), Vietnam (BROMAKE VIETNAM COMPANY LIMITED), and Hong Kong (BROMAKE (HONGKONG) INVESTMENT LIMITED), serving North American and Southeast Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It processes raw materials (plastics, carbon fiber, plant-based materials) into finished protective and functional components for consumer electronics manufacturers. The company sources materials from suppliers and delivers finished products directly to OEMs and contract manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on the 'Green, Light, New' (绿、轻、新) development strategy emphasizing environmental protection, lightweight materials, and process innovation. R&D initiatives include AI PC thermal management solutions, foldable phone structural components, carbon fiber applications expansion, biodegradable materials development, and recycled material utilization. The company invested 52.45 million yuan in R&D (5.21% of revenue) with 143 R&D personnel.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of protective and functional materials. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control to customers through various delivery modes: VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) model, domestic sales with customer signature, and international sales via FOB and DAP terms. The company operates on a B2B model with framework agreements and purchase orders from customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading comprehensive solution provider for protective and functional materials in consumer electronics. It competes on technology innovation, product customization capability, regional production network efficiency, and customer service responsiveness. The company has successfully achieved domestic substitution in carbon fiber products, breaking foreign technology barriers, and maintains competitive advantages through differentiated product offerings and deep customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2023 revenue of 1.0067 billion yuan, representing 1.09% growth from 2022. Net profit attributable to parent company was 114.67 million yuan. Total assets reached 2.051 billion yuan (60.50% increase from prior year), with shareholders' equity of 1.645 billion yuan (186.51% increase). The company completed IPO in April 2023, raising 1.004 billion yuan in net proceeds, significantly strengthening its financial position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through comprehensive one-stop solutions combining protective and functional materials, advanced customization capabilities, and environmental sustainability focus. Key differentiators include: proprietary carbon fiber lightweight technology, biodegradable and recyclable material innovations, efficient regional production network enabling rapid customer response, deep technical collaboration with customers in product development, and commitment to ESG standards through ocean-bound plastic (OBP) and plant-based material applications.
